{{Top|leg}}
A '''high-frequency transmitter''' was a communications device fitted. They were fitted to [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] at the behest of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. High-frequency transmitters allowed probe droids to instantaneously transmit their findings back to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to prevent any delay in information acquired by the droid.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine]]s were fitted with narrow-band high frequency transmitters to contact the [[Mine/Legends|mine's]] control station once the onboard [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] had disabled a target.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
